title: Search Mechanics
summary: improve the separate domain-owned search systems by establishing one Docs Viewer inverted-index format before expanding Studio retrieval to full text
content_html:
Search Mechanics

Refine index inclusion, ranking, result context, and efficiency while retaining the current separate Catalogue and Docs Viewer static-search structure.

Feature Documents

  • DSI-1 — Docs Viewer Search Index v2 Delivery — complete and closed; every Docs Viewer scope uses one inverted-index structure and one browser query path.
  • SM-1 — Studio Full-Text Search Delivery — eligible for readiness; proposed Studio heading, body, and code retrieval has not begun.
  • Search — current architecture and known weak spots.

Studio Documentation Maintenance rationalised the Studio corpus and added exact same-scope backlink visibility before search delivery. Completed DSI-1 prevents Studio full text from creating a second Docs Viewer index reader; SM-1 may now begin its separate read-only readiness step as a Studio field-policy extension. Catalogue Search remains a separate later mechanics delivery.
